detail: Model-owned confirmed status survives assembly and produces a task without human review.
Existing quote permits inconsistent normalized fact/event/date.
Report overview includes unconfirmed, unreferenced profile summary.
Actual upload-change callback clears both existing case and task states before replacement succeeds.
Schema cannot represent an event with unknown date; structured extraction must omit it or fail.
Same bytes under different filenames receive distinct document IDs.
Duplicate fact IDs accepted; UI widget keys and review mapping cannot disambiguate them.
Frequency is display text only; today has no effect and recurrence is not expanded.
